sloka: तां तु पार्श्वस्थितां प्रह्वां रामः सम्प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम् ।हृदयान्तर्गतक्रोधो व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। ६.११८.१ ।।
transliteration: tāṁ tu pārśvasthitāṁ prahvāṁ rāmaḥ samprekṣya maithilīm ।hṛdayāntargatakrodho vyāhartumupacakrame ।। 6.118.1 ।।

translations.english: Observing Mythili who stood near him, Rama started to give expression to what was in his heart.
